items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen in walks of 10 to 19 minutes. You walked after 3 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a bigger rise in sugar, with dinners from 8-9 pm having a particularly big effect. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see if it makes a difference for you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: You are already averaging 14.1 hours of overnight fasting, which is a good habit to keep up. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed some numbers in a study, but it's not clear how it affects everyone yet.
